title: Serial Divisible-by-3 Detector

forbidden.message: no division or modulo operators: this is an FSM puzzle
no division, mod or rem: this is an FSM puzzle

constraints: Bits arrive MSB first, one per rising edge. After reset the number is 0.
`div = 1` when the number formed by all bits received since reset is divisible by 3 (so `div = 1` right after reset).
The number can grow without bound, so you cannot store it. No `/`, `%`, `mod` or `rem`.
Moore output. Synchronous reset. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Appending a bit b to a number n gives 2n + b.
You only need n mod 3. What is (2n + b) mod 3 in terms of (n mod 3) and b?
Three states: remainder 0, 1 and 2. From remainder r with input b you go to (2r + b) mod 3. Write the 6 transitions as a table.

examples.title: long stream
examples.expected: div follows (number mod 3 == 0) after every bit
